page_title: AI YouTube Thumbnail Maker & Generator – Try It Free

sources.entry: ThumbnailSnap - Generates YouTube, Shorts and TikTok thumbnails with AI and keeps the title as an editable text layer; cropping your own photo and adding text is free. #freemium

summary.name: ThumbnailSnap
summary.one_liner: A browser-based YouTube thumbnail maker that crops and adds text to your own photo for free, or generates 16:9 thumbnails with AI from a video idea or YouTube link.
use_cases: Making a YouTube thumbnail from your own photo
Generating a 16:9 thumbnail with AI from a video idea
Adding editable headline text to a thumbnail
Creating 9:16 covers for Shorts, TikTok or Reels
Editing an existing thumbnail's background or removing objects
summary.what_it_does: Creates YouTube thumbnails and 9:16 covers for Shorts, TikTok and Reels from a photo, a sentence describing the video, or a public YouTube link (it reads only the title and channel). Cropping your own picture and adding text is free in the browser with no watermark and no sign-up. AI generation produces a text-free image, and the headline is added as real, editable typography so spelling stays correct and words can be changed without regenerating. Exports are 1280×720 JPG (kept under 2 MB) or PNG. It can also edit thumbnails you already have.
notable: AI headline text is added as editable typography rather than generated into the image
Free cropping, text and download of your own pictures with no watermark
Accepts YouTube links to read public title and channel
Exports 1280×720 JPG under 2 MB for mobile upload
caveats: AI generation needs a free account; new accounts get 12 credits, and AI cover costs 4 to 6 credits, AI edit 2 credits
AI pictures exported on the free plan carry a small corner mark removed by any purchase
Links are read only for YouTube; TikTok and Instagram links are not read, and larger-than-1280×720 exports are not offered yet
